verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an observability SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents a way to disable vendor telemetry or usage tracking. Self-hosting, which keeps trace data in your own environment, is a related deployment option rather than an opt-out control, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
